premises.text: New care and payment models create demand for patient relationship management software
premises.evidence_span: There's new care and payment models that are coming out and really disrupting the current model. With that, though, there's a demand for a new category of software we call patient relationship management

premises.text: PRM is like Salesforce for healthcare but the patient uses the software too
premises.evidence_span: think of it a little bit like salesforce.com for healthcare, with the key exception being the customer, aka the patient, is actually using the software as well

premises.text: Healthcare works best and costs least when patient and provider partner
premises.evidence_span: healthcare works best and costs least when there's a partnership between the patient and the provider

premises.text: Services framework delivers care-plan trackers and notifications for appointments, vitals, and wellness
premises.evidence_span: pregnancy tracker is a set of notifications that remind her about upcoming appointments, what vitals to track, other health and wellness information that's key for her. And this is built in what we think of as kind of our secret sauce, the Avado services framework

premises.text: Product focuses on the 99% of life outside the office visit where health is maintained or lost
premises.evidence_span: that other 99% that is so critical to maintaining or returning you or a family member to health. And that other 99% is our focus

premises.text: Connected check-in shares meds, conditions, allergies, and insurance to streamline appointments
premises.evidence_span: brings up your connected health record. Connected is the operative word. It's bringing in the latest information of your medications, your conditions, your allergies, insurance information, and then you send that off to your doctor

premises.text: Freemium features drive use and virality; premium and third-party services monetize
premises.evidence_span: the features that are free are ones that actually drive use and virality. And then the services is some of the magic in our business model where both Avado and third-party services come in there

value.text: Longer, higher-quality life at lower cost via empowered patient-provider partnership
value.evidence_span: you can live a longer life, higher quality, and actually pay less in the process

causal_links.evidence_span: healthcare works best and costs least when there's a partnership between the patient and the provider
features that are free are ones that actually drive use and virality

notes: Healthcare spend chart and chronic-condition dollar stats used as context; mechanism coded is partnership + out-of-visit engagement, not the spend number. Early-adopter segment list treated as GTM color inside notes, not separate premises. Ten man-years development excluded as traction.
